scope: Exact caller-pinned core-Wasm artifact inspection for numeric function signatures and exported memory address widths before adapter instantiation.
rules: copy and verify the exact binary under wasm-binary/webassembly-core/1
validate/compile the copied bytes with the selected WebAssembly engine without instantiating them
account for imported functions and each type in explicit recursive groups, including GC structs/arrays and subtypes
retain reference types as nonnumeric metadata; numeric adapter requirements reject them
preserve every UTF-8 export/import name code point, including an initial BOM
read nonshared memory32/memory64 limits with bounded unsigned-64 decoding
reject unexpected signatures, memory widths, unsupported type/limit forms and exhausted metadata budgets
return immutable metadata and use private inspection handles for signature requirements
resources: Input bytes, names and decoded metadata entries are bounded. Engine compilation and platform allocation remain host runtime assumptions, not a global resource proof.
authority: Binary/interface inspection data only. It does not independently validate instructions, prove behavior or source preservation, execute imports/start functions, or create compiler/kernel authority.
remaining: general Canonical call/import lifecycle; closed synchronous export binding is implemented separately
validation: 79a90af passed full main cloud CI (37656246970/job 112912009591), including real-engine signature/index/start/name cases and literal exact-name/numeric regressions.
